articles.summary: Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (“IRT”) (NYSE: IRT) announces the release date and conference call details related to its third quarter 2026 financial results. Details: Results Release Date: Monday, November 2, 2026, after the market closes Conference Call Date and Time: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time Live Webcast: https://investors.irtliving.com Replay Information: Shortly after the live conference call concludes, a webcast replay will be available on IRT’s Investor Relations website, https://investors.irtliving.com . About IRT: Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT), an SP 400 MidCap Company, is a real estate investment trust that owns and operates multifamily communities, across non-gateway U.S. markets. IRT’s investment strategy is focused on gaining scale near major employment centers within key amenity-rich submarkets that offer good school districts and high-quality retail.
